sequence.detail: A path-extraction heuristic was applied over the plan JSON.
The heuristic nearly produced a false 19-of-20-paths-missing finding.
The reviewer inspected the plan's actual commit-SHA binding mechanism.
The inaccurate interpretation was killed before it reached the recipient as a finding.

non_claims: The withdrawn heuristic result is not a defect in PR #64.
The near miss does not establish that every future reviewer will correct a degraded representation.
Preserving this process evidence does not grant review, merge, admission, authority, or execution standing.
